Title: Markdown Preview
Description: Write Markdown with a live HTML preview side by side: GitHub Flavored tables, task lists, strikethrough. Copy sanitized HTML or download an .html file.
Keywords: markdown preview, markdown editor online, markdown to html, live markdown editor, gfm preview, markdown table, readme preview
Heading: Heading

Seo_Introduction: Type Markdown on one side and see the rendered result on the other as you type — handy for drafting READMEs, issue comments, documentation and release notes, then exporting them as HTML.
Seo_DetailedDescription:
Rendering uses the marked library with GitHub Flavored Markdown: tables, task lists `- [x]`, strikethrough `~~text~~`, fenced code blocks and automatic links for bare URLs. A single line break becomes `
`, as in GitHub comments, so lines are not merged into one paragraph. Code blocks are shown in a monospace font without syntax coloring. Raw HTML inside the Markdown is sanitized: scripts, iframes, forms, styles and event attributes such as `onclick` are removed and `javascript:` links are blocked, while harmless tags like ``, `
` or `` are kept. Links open in a new tab. In the preview, headings are shown one level lower so they do not compete with the page title; **Copy HTML** and **Download HTML** keep the original `

`–`

`. The toolbar inserts bold, italic, heading, link, image, inline code and list syntax at the cursor, and **Sync Scroll** keeps both panes at the same relative position. Everything runs in the browser and the tool does not save your text — copy it before closing the page.
Seo_Examples:
**Task list**: `- [x] tests` and `- [ ] docs` render as a checked and an unchecked checkbox. **Line breaks**: the two lines `line one` and `line two ~~old~~` become `

line one
line two old

`. **Table**: the rows `| A | B |`, `|---|---|`, `| 1 | 2 |` become an HTML table with a header row. **Unsafe HTML**: `hi` is exported as just `hi`.
Seo_HowToSteps:
### Step 1: Write Markdown
Type in **Markdown Editor**. A sample document is shown on first open; press **Clear** to start from an empty page.

### Step 2: Format with the toolbar
Select text and use the formatting buttons (bold, italic, heading, link, image, code, list) to insert the syntax.

### Step 3: Check the preview
The **Preview** pane updates on every keystroke; turn **Sync Scroll** on to scroll both panes together.

### Step 4: Export
Use **Copy HTML** or **Copy Markdown**, or **Download HTML** to save `markdown-preview.html` with basic styles.
Seo_Tips:
- Relative image paths such as `img/logo.png` cannot be resolved here; use full `https://` URLs to see images.
- Images from other sites are loaded by your browser directly from those servers.
- GitHub-only extras — `@mentions`, emoji shortcodes like `:smile:`, Mermaid diagrams and math — are shown as plain text.
- Inline HTML such as `<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>` or `<details>` works, but `style` and `class` attributes are stripped.
- The downloaded file is a standalone page with light styles that is ready to print or attach.
